glosses: basic (of or pertaining to a base; having a pH greater than 7)

examples.en: Do you go to an elementary school?

examples.text: La migración es un derecho humano básico.
examples.en: Migration is a basic human right.

examples.text: Es uno de los instintos humanos básicos.
examples.en: It's one of the basic human instincts.

examples.text: Esto apenas cubre nuestros gastos básicos.
examples.en: This just barely covers our living expenses.
